steps.title: 1. Presets
steps.description: Step 1: Choose a Quick Preset or configure settings step-by-step

presets.title: 🚀 Open Hub Multiworld (Recommended)
presets.desc: Start at the Sector Hub with unlocked elevators, guaranteed early progression, and quality-of-life.

presets.title: 👾 Metroid Boss Hunt
presets.desc: Infant Metroids exclusively awarded by major X-Parasite bosses, starting with an Energy Tank and Major Upgrade.

presets.title: 🌀 Station Entrance Chaos
presets.desc: Shuffled sector connection tubes, shuffled elevators, beginner tricks required, and DeathLink active.

steps.title: 2. Game Mode & Station Hub
steps.description: Step 2: Choose station accessibility, starting location, and elevator connections

items.title: Open Sector Hub (Standard)
items.desc: Main elevator access to Sectors 1-6 is open, offering nonlinear exploration across B.S.L.

items.title: Vanilla Progression
items.desc: Classic linear story progression unlocking sectors sequentially via Operations Deck orders.

items.title: Sector Hub
items.desc: Start at the central hub with direct elevator shafts to Sectors 1-6.

items.title: Docking Bay
items.desc: Start at Samus's gunship in the Main Deck Docking Bay.

items.title: Operations Deck
items.desc: Start near the Main Deck operations room.

items.title: Concourse Save Station
items.desc: Start at the Main Deck concourse save room.

controls.label: Open Sector Elevators (Sector elevators unlock without vanilla keycard requirements)
Shuffle Sector Tubes (Randomizes connection tubes linking different sectors)

items.title: Vanilla Elevators
items.desc: All elevator shafts lead to their vanilla destinations.

items.title: Shuffle Sector Elevators
items.desc: Sector Hub elevators connect to randomized sector shafts.

items.title: Shuffle All Elevators
items.desc: Every elevator across B.S.L. connects to a random destination.

steps.title: 3. Win Condition (Infant Metroids)
steps.description: Step 3: Configure Infant Metroid rescue requirements and goal locations

controls.label: Infant Metroids Required to Beat the Game
Total Infant Metroids in Item Pool

items.title: Placed Anywhere
items.desc: Infant Metroids can appear in any item check across the station.

items.title: Bosses Encouraged
items.desc: Higher probability of Metroids placed on major X-parasite bosses.

items.title: Only Bosses
items.desc: Infant Metroids are exclusively awarded by defeating bosses.

items.title: Early Progression (Normal)
items.desc: Guarantees a key progression item in one of your early reachable checks.

items.title: Advanced Early Logic
items.desc: Allows more complex sequence breaks in early checks.

items.title: No Guarantee (None)
items.desc: Completely random item distribution from check 1.

steps.title: 4. Movement Tricks & Logic
steps.description: Step 4: Configure required shinespark tricks, wall jumps, and combat expectations

items.title: No Shinespark Tricks
items.desc: No advanced Speed Booster tricks required in logic.

items.title: Beginner Shinesparks
items.desc: Requires basic shinespark storage, straight charges, and standard ramps.

items.title: Advanced Shinesparks
items.desc: Expects mid-air spark resets, spark cancels, and complex tight maneuvers.

items.title: No Wall Jump Tricks
items.desc: No wall jump mastery required to progress.

items.title: Beginner Wall Jumps
items.desc: Requires basic single-wall climbs and easy wall jumps.

items.title: Advanced Wall Jumps
items.desc: Expects continuous vertical climbs up single flat shafts without Space Jump.

items.title: Beginner Combat
items.desc: Expects adequate health and beam/missile upgrades for late bosses.

items.title: Advanced Combat
items.desc: Expects defeating bosses with fewer health tanks and weapon upgrades.

items.title: Expert Combat
items.desc: Late-game bosses in logic with minimal Energy Tanks and base weapons.

controls.label: Include Point of No Return Locations in Logic (Ensures one-way drops are logically safe)

steps.title: 5. Starting Gear & Quality of Life
steps.description: Step 5: Configure starting tanks, revealed blocks, door transitions, and multiworld

controls.label: Starting Major Upgrades (Morph Ball, Missiles, Beams, etc.)
Reveal Hidden Blocks (Destructible pit/bomb blocks are visible from the start)
Fast Door Transitions (Removes door animation delays for fast room transitions)
Enable In-Game Hints (Navigation Terminals provide item location hints)
DeathLink (Share Samus's deaths across the multiworld)
